name: mirage
text: Likely cause found in Kalshi's docs: Kalshi splits an account's money across exchange shards, and an order can only spend the balance on its own shard ('programmatic traders normally need to fund the relevant shard before placing an order'). The $6.29 the app reads is the total across shards, so the shard that the football markets trade on may hold $0. I'm making the app show the cash per shard so we can confirm, and dropping the old-route attempt (Kalshi retired it). Then I'll add a button to move your cash to the right shard, but only with your OK since it moves money inside your Kalshi account.
